questions.question: The ________ is the site of the complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**small intestine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** small intestine** is the site of the complete digestion of **carbohydrates, proteins and fats** because it is the** longest part** of the digestive system and has specialized structures called **villi and microvilli **that increase its **surface area for absorption.**
 
• **Carbohydrates **are broken down into simple sugars like** glucose**, **proteins** are broken down into **amino acids, **and **fats **are broken down into **fatty acids and glycerol **in the small intestine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** small intestine** is divided into three parts: **duodenum, jejunum and ileum, **with the duodenum being the first and shortest segment that receives** digestive enzymes** from the pancreas and** bile from the liver.**
 
• The** liver **is the **largest gland** in the body and performs many important functions, including **detoxifying harmful substances, storing vitamins and minerals,** and **producing blood-clotting proteins.**
 
• The large intestine is about **1.5 meters long** and has four main regions:** cecum, colon, rectum and anal canal**, with the colon being the longest part that is further divided into** ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid segments.**
 
• The food pipe is a muscular tube that is about **25 centimeters long** and has two sphincters, one at the upper end near the **throat **and one at the lower end near the **stomach**, that prevent food and **stomach acid** from flowing back.

questions.question: Identify the writ by the virtue of which the Court directs a detained person to be brought before it to examine the legality of his detention.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Habeas Corpus.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Habeas Corpus** is a** Latin term **that means** "you shall have the body."**
 
• It is a legal writ that allows a **detained person to challenge the legality **of their detention and seek release from custody.
 
• The writ of Habeas Corpus is considered a** fundamental safeguard** against **arbitrary detention** and is enshrined in many legal systems around the world, including the United States Constitution.
 
• When a person files a petition for a writ of Habeas Corpus, they are asking a court to order the person or entity holding them in custody to bring them before the court and** justify their detention.**
 
• The court will then** examine the evidence** and determine whether the detention is lawful or not.
 
• The writ of Habeas Corpus can be used in a variety of situations, such as when a person is being held in** jail without trial**, when they are being held by a **foreign government, **or when they are being held by a **private individual or organization.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandamus** is a writ that orders a government official or agency to perform a **specific duty.**
 
• **Certiorari** is a writ that allows a higher court to** review the decision **of a lower court.
 
• **Quo Warranto **is a writ that challenges a person's** right to hold a particular public office or position.**

questions.question: The Prarthana Samaj was established in ________ in Bombay.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1867.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Prarthana Samaj** was established in **Bombay in 1867** by **Atmaram Pandurang.**
 
• It was a **reformist movement** that aimed to promote** monotheism **and reject** idol worship, caste system, **and other superstitious practices in Hinduism.
 
• The Prarthana Samaj also advocated for** social and educational reforms,** such as women's education, widow remarriage, and abolition of child marriage.
 
• The movement had a significant impact on the Indian society and inspired other reformist movements like the **Brahmo Samaj and the Arya Samaj.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bombay **(now Mumbai) was a major center of** social and political reform movements **in colonial India, with many prominent reformers and activists based in the city.
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang,** the founder of the Prarthana Samaj, was a** scholar and social reformer **who had earlier been associated with the **Brahmo Samaj and the Prarthana Sabha.**
 
• The **Brahmo Samaj**, founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy in 1828,** was another important reformist movement that aimed to promote **rationalism, social equality, and religious tolerance.**
 
• **The Arya Samaj,** founded by **Swami Dayanand Saraswati in 1875**, was a **Hindu revivalist movement** that aimed to promote Vedic values and reject Western influence and social evils.

questions.question: Respecting the national anthem and national flag is:

options.text: a fundamental right of every citizen
an ordinary duty of every citizen
a fundamental duty of every citizen
a legal right of every citizen

questions.solution:
The correct answer is a __**fundamental duty of every citizen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Respecting the **national anthem and national flag** is a fundamental duty of every citizen in India as per **Article 51A** of the** Indian Constitution.**
 
• This means that every citizen is expected to** show respect **towards the national anthem and flag and not indulge in any act that disrespects them.
 
• The government of India has also laid down guidelines for the **proper use and display** of the national flag and violation of these guidelines can lead to legal action.
 
• It is important to note that while respecting the national anthem and flag is a** fundamental duty,** it is not the only fundamental duty of a citizen.
 
• Other fundamental duties include **promoting harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood** amongst all people of India, safeguarding public property, and protecting the natural environment.
